ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'right and left' signify in Surah Al-Ma'arij regarding the gathering of disbelievers?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the overwhelming magnitude of the disbelievers' gathering, emphasizing their helplessness as they are crowded together without any escape routes. The phrase 'neither from the right nor from the left' underscores the completeness of their confinement and the futility of seeking intercession or refuge from any direction during the final reckoning.
